title: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
summary: With Saturday’s success, Isar is the clear leader among a pack of several European launch startups vying to inject some competition into Europe’s stagnant launch market. Isar’s Spectrum slides in below the performance envelope of the Vega-C rocket from Italy’s Avio .
